definitions.gloss: personal matter; private affair; private business
definitions.explanation: Something that belongs to one's private life rather than work or public affairs. Often used as a polite preface when bringing up personal topics in a professional or formal setting.

examples.japanese: {私事|しじ}⟦にわたる→にわたる：32502_niwataru⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{答|こた}え→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I can't answer questions that touch on private matters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{私事|しじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not use company equipment for personal purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{私事|しじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦きちんと→きちんと：00222_kichinto⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: One should properly separate work and personal matters.

notes:
Composed of {私|し} (private/personal) + {事|じ} (matter/affair). A formal, mainly written word for private or personal matters, as opposed to public or official business.

PRONUNCIATION:
In polite prefaces such as {私事|わたくしごと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧, the reading is わたくしごと; しじ belongs to written and official language.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私事|しじ}⟦にわたる→にわたる：32502_niwataru⟧: to touch on private matters
- {私事|しじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{優先|ゆうせん}→優先：15243_yuusen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prioritize personal matters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{個人的|こじんてき}→個人的：04788_kojinteki⟧なこと: personal thing — more casual, everyday usage
- ⟦{公私|こうし}→公私：21213_koushi⟧: public and private (matters) — used for the contrast between work and personal life
- ⟦{私用|しよう}→私用：00459_shiyou⟧: personal use/business — focuses on activities done for personal reasons
